//: Root config for editors and tooling that resolve upward from the repo root. It deliberately compiles nothing: apps/web-client and apps/llm each own a real tsconfig, and this file exists only so a tool that finds it first gets sane defaults instead of an error. It used to extend expo/tsconfig.base, which is not a dependency of this repo (there is no Expo app here), so every tsc invocation that reached it emitted 'Cannot find base config file'.
